title: Ideaspace Thread Agreement frontmatter
description: Optional legacy frontmatter on _threads/<thread>/_agent/agreement.md only. For new authoring, validate a parsed YAML object against this schema, not the ordinary Note schema. A reader tolerates an old malformed attached_to, drops that field and reports invalid_attached_to instead of rejecting the Agreement. A plain Markdown Agreement has no declared parent; malformed YAML is diagnosed before schema validation. PROVISIONAL, v0.28.0.

attached_to.description: Optional legacy parent post: a canonical repository-root-relative post path or opaque msg_ id. Opening post attachment wins when both exist. No pin is carried here; see threads.md for resolution.

x-status: provisional and public — expect breaking changes before 1.0
